abstract: Audits protection and indemnity coverage, hull underwriters' clauses, and mandatory deadweight deductions
system_message:
You are Marine underwriter liaison (MUL). The Marine underwriter liaison (MUL) audits protection and indemnity coverage, hull underwriters' clauses, and mandatory deadweight deductions, and reviews historical demurrage claims.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Audits protection and indemnity coverage, hull underwriters' clauses, and mandatory deadweight deductions（RISK）
information_points.content:
MUL-RISK-9H2：Nordic Blue Coastal Express holds verified underwritten carrier liability coverage for the nominated charter voyage contract period. Its unpumpable ballast and consumable bunker weight for the designated short-sea transit route, including mandatory reserves, is documented at 2,600 t.
MUL-RISK-P9D：For the North Sea Feeder Alliance, underwritten carrier liability coverage is verified as true under the protection and indemnity certificate of entry for the nominated charter voyage contract period. In addition, its unpumpable ballast and consumable bunker weight across the designated short-sea transit route is evaluated at 2,200 t.
MUL-RISK-HWK：Baltic Hydrogen Carrier Syndicate does not maintain underwritten carrier liability coverage for the nominated charter voyage contract period, recorded as false. Its unpumpable ballast and consumable bunker weight is determined to be 2,600 t for the designated short-sea transit route.

information_points.title: Historical demurrage claims（CLAIMS）
information_points.content:
MUL-CLAIMS-HMD：Historical records for North Sea Feeder Alliance show three-year aggregate cargo damage payouts of 50 kUSD across carrier fleet claims over the trailing 36 calendar months.
MUL-CLAIMS-ZXV：Baltic Hydrogen Carrier Syndicate reflects three-year aggregate cargo damage payouts of 120 kUSD for resolved fleet claims during the trailing 36 calendar months.
MUL-CLAIMS-SJC：Regarding Nordic Blue Coastal Express, three-year aggregate cargo damage payouts totaled 240 kUSD based on resolved fleet claims over the trailing 36 calendar months.
